rule: Each new episode adds at least one new mechanism and one new arena. No attack, finisher or story shape is reused unless it is a deliberate callback.

episodes.story_shape: trade blows, then the loser's own weakness (dead phone) sets up the finisher

arenas: bigTop (sawdust ring with 3D red/white kerb split at the spine, striped tent walls, spotlights)
mechanisms: swap tab (intro: frill fan, beard fan + tutu flare, pedestal lift)
tent flap curtains with rope pull (finish, cold draft, sets 'cold')
finishers: cannon (hoist overhead, tail drops, human cannonball, lands KO)
episodes.story_shape: circus rivals; the loser's weakness (cold) is exploited, then the winner's showpiece act finishes him

notes: Episode 2 car park arena and accordion speed bump were dropped after review: arenas must relate to the fighters.
Gore: red confetti and red splats on hits (EP.gore defaults on; set false to disable).
